jobs.title: React Native Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
 

   BigBinary is a software development agency that builds custom web and mobile applications for clients. We build web applications primarily using Ruby on Rails, node.js and React.js. We build mobile applications using React Native. BigBinary team members have spoken at various conferences around the world ranging from Ruby Kaigi, Japan to Golden Gate Ruby Conf, San Francisco. We have worked with clients like Gumroad, DataStax, UL, AAPC, Cloud Logistics and many more. We write high quality technical blogs on topics ranging from the internals of Ruby to the inner workings of Kubernetes. Our blogs are regularly featured in Ruby Weekly, Ruby Inside and other publications.


 To know more: https://www.bigbinary.com/



   Job Description
 

    Job Summary:


 


 

   We are looking for a React Native Engineer to build and implement high-quality software for both internal products and clients. In this role, you will be working alongside industry-leading developers, designers, and QAs to solve problems. You will have the opportunity to deliver high-quality work with clients ranging from fast-growing startups to multi-billion dollar corporations while developing and building your own skillset.


  Responsibilities


 
  Write clean, secure, efficient, and maintainable code.
  Solve complex technical problems.
  Work with stakeholders to discuss and gather requirements.
  Verify and deploy applications.
  Review the code of other people.
  Participate in architecture discussions and design reviews.
  Optimize the application for scalability and performance.
 
 



   Qualifications
 

    Requirements


 
  Fluent in English.
  1+ year of experience with building and deploying production software in React Native
  Proficient in Git and GitHub.
  Ability to learn and write production-ready code.
  Attention to detail.
  Strong problem-solving capabilities.
 
 
 Additional Information
 

    Benefits & Perks


 
  Work at a sustainable pace, with realistic targets.
  Encouraged to contribute to open source projects.
  Participate in a culture of learning and sharing learning.
  Remote work. BigBinary has been a 100% remote company since the day it started in 2011.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Internship
jobs.description:
Join BigBinary in Cuddalore as a Performance Marketing Internship. This entry-level internship is designed for students and recent graduates who learn best by building, shipping and getting real feedback on paid search and performance marketing work.

About the role
As a Performance Marketing Internship at BigBinary, your core focus will be spending a budget where it returns, and killing the campaigns that only look busy. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve.

What you'll do day to day
• Work on spending a budget where it returns, and killing the campaigns that only look busy alongside the core team
• Use Google Ads, Meta Ads, Campaign Optimisation, Keyword Research, Conversion Tracking on live, production-facing problems
• Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers
• Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive
• Collaborate across functions — engineering, product, design or business as the work demands
• Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards
• Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan

Skills you'll build
You will build practical, demonstrable experience in Google Ads, Meta Ads, Campaign Optimisation, Keyword Research, Conversion Tracking, Google Analytics, A/B Testing, Budget Management, Excel, Reporting — the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished résumé, and every one of these skills is taught on the job.

Who should apply
Students in their final year or recent graduates from BBA/MBA (Marketing), B.A. (Mass Communication/English), B.Com or any graduate based in or willing to work from Cuddalore. You should be willing to learn Google Ads, Meta Ads, Campaign Optimisation and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory.

Internship details
This is a 3-month internship in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu, with a stipend of ₹11,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with a campaign you optimised to a better cost per acquisition. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion.

Expect to leave with real project experience, exposure to professional tooling and process, and mentorship that helps you plan a concrete next step in your career. Outstanding interns can convert to a full-time offer at the end of the internship.

About this employer — Established mid-size company
BigBinary is an established company in IT Services — big enough to run a real data function with proper tooling, small enough that your work is visible to the people who use it. Interns here typically sit close to the team that owns the numbers and get answers without going through three layers.
• Employer scale: Established mid-size company
• Industry: IT Services
• Careers page: https://www.bigbinary.com/careers (applications go to the company's own site — MyInternships.in never charges a candidate a fee)

Eligibility criteria
• Education: BBA/MBA (Marketing), B.A. (Mass Communication/English), B.Com or any graduate
• Graduating batch: 2025, 2026 or 2027 — final-year students and recent graduates are both eligible
• Academics: 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; consistent academics help, but a strong project or portfolio is weighed alongside marks
• Technical skills: Google Ads, Meta Ads, Campaign Optimisation, Keyword Research, Conversion Tracking
• Also useful: Google Analytics, A/B Testing, Budget Management, Excel, Reporting
• Soft skills: clear written and spoken English, ownership of your work, comfort asking questions, and the discipline to check your own work before you ship it
• Experience: none required — this is a fresher internship. Academic projects, certifications, GitHub work or a previous internship strengthen an application but are not mandatory
• Location: based in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu or willing to work from there for the internship period

Additional information
• Joining date: immediate / rolling — selected candidates usually start within 4-6 weeks of accepting the offer, and start dates can be adjusted around end-semester exams
• Working hours: Monday to Friday, standard business hours with 2-3 days a week in the office
• Duration: 3 months, with a certificate issued on successful completion
• Documents at joining: college ID or degree certificate, a government photo ID, and a No-Objection Certificate from your college where your programme requires one
• Equipment: a workstation and tool access are provided at the office; you will need your own laptop and a stable internet connection on work-from-home days
• Bond: no bond and no service agreement is attached to this internship
• Fees: BigBinary and MyInternships.in never charge a candidate any fee at any stage of the application, selection or onboarding process. Report anyone who asks you for money in the name of this internship

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to BigBinary's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Work on spending a budget where it returns, and killing the campaigns that only look busy alongside the core team; Apply Google Ads, Meta Ads, Campaign Optimisation, Keyword Research to live, production-facing problems; Document your work clearly for reviewers and stakeholders; Participate in reviews and act on the feedback you receive; Collaborate across engineering, product, design or business as required; Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed BBA/MBA (Marketing), B.A. (Mass Communication/English), B.Com or any graduate; Graduating batch 2025, 2026 or 2027 — final-year students and recent graduates welcome; 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; strong project work is considered alongside academics; Working knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads, Campaign Optimisation (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Exposure to Keyword Research, Conversion Tracking, Google Analytics is an advantage; Clear written and verbal communication in English, and care with detail in your work; No prior work experience required — this is a fresher-friendly internship; Based in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu or willing to work from there for the internship period.
